text: きょうも　おとうとを　きたえるの　てつだって！

structure.jp: おとうとを　きたえるの

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing, like '-ing' in English; the を after it is dropped in casual speech. おとうとを　きたえるの = 'training my little brother'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb on its own is a casual request. てつだって = 'help me'.
